                        List of Warnings and Cautions

WARNING 1.1           . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . 19
               A warning is information about procedures, tasks, or conditions with a risk of fatal or serious

CAUTION 1.1             . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . 19
               A caution is information about procedures, tasks, or conditions with a risk of damage to the
                  equipment, data, or the environment, if you do not obey the instructions.

WARNING 1.2           . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . 20
               Do not use this equipment without an electrically grounded connection to prevent an
                       electrical shock. If you ignore this warning, you can cause fatal injury.

WARNING 1.3           . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . 24
               Do not use parts or accessories unless they are supplied or approved by Elekta. If you ignore
                       this warning, you can cause fatal injury, clinical mistreatment, and damage to the equipment.

WARNING 1.4           . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . 25
               Do not operate the equipment unless the QA checks are satisfactorily completed. If you
                    ignore this warning, you can cause fatal injury, clinical mistreatment, and damage to the
                  equipment.

WARNING 1.5           . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . 25
               Do not operate the equipment if it is damaged, defective, or incorrectly calibrated. If you
                    ignore this warning, you can cause fatal injury, clinical mistreatment, and damage to the
                  equipment.

WARNING 1.6           . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . 26
               Do not remove, change, or override the switches, interlocks, or other safety devices unless
                     special instructions in this document tell you to. The result can be incorrect radiation delivery
                 and other safety risks. When the work is completed, set all the safety devices again and do a
                      test of them. If you ignore this warning, it can cause fatal injury or clinical mistreatment.

WARNING 1.7           . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . 26
               Do not put the cardiac pacemaker, other implant or portable electronic medical device, in the
                     radiation beam. If you ignore this warning, you can cause fatal injury.

WARNING 1.8           . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . 26
               Do not deliver radiation treatment unless you continuously monitor the operation of the
                    cardiac pacemaker, other implant or portable electronic medical device. If you ignore this
                   warning, you can cause fatal injury.

WARNING 1.9           . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . 27
               Do not start the work on the linear accelerator before you isolate the power to the work area
                     at the interface cabinet. If you ignore this warning, you can get a high voltage electric shock. A
                   high voltage electric shock can cause fatal injury.

WARNING 1.10         . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . 27
                  There continues to be a risk of high voltage electric shock after the power supply switch of the
                 equipment is put in the OFF position. Some of the customer interfaces can continue to supply
                       electrical power to the electrical terminals. This can give you a high voltage electric shock. If
                 you ignore this warning, a high voltage electric shock can cause fatal injury.
